nusmp.companion.disabled: The companion system is switched off (companions.enabled).
nusmp.companion.join.full: You already have as many companions walking with you as you can.
nusmp.companion.bond.put: Put what I am holding in the pouch
nusmp.companion.bond.use.on: Let her use the pouch on me when I am hurt
nusmp.companion.bond.use.off: Do not let her use the pouch on me
nusmp.companion.bond.use.set.on: She will look after you from the pouch when you are hurt.
nusmp.companion.bond.use.set.off: She will leave the pouch alone.
nusmp.companion.bond.pouch.locked: The pouch is for the one she walks with, or for a friend while she walks with nobody.
nusmp.companion.charmy.sub: Cotton and Food Mage of the Black Bulls
nusmp.companion.charmy.greet: Oh, %s! Did you bring snacks? ...I mean, hello!
nusmp.companion.charmy.q.food: What do you like to eat?
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.self: I'm Charmy Pappitson of the Black Bulls! Cotton Magic and Food Magic, that's me. And if you've got food, you're my favourite person.
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.food: Everything! But cake, pumpkin pie and cookies most of all. Ask me what I like if you want the whole list.
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.magic: Cotton Magic: fluffy, soft and stronger than it looks. And Food Magic, which is the best kind of magic there is.
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.join: Yay, an adventure! Is there food on the way? Lead on!
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.wait: Okay, I'll wait right here. Don't be gone long!
nusmp.companion.charmy.join.need: Share a snack with me first. Then we can talk about walking together.
nusmp.companion.charmy.join.taken: I'm walking with someone else right now.
nusmp.companion.charmy.use: Here, have this %s! You look terrible!
nusmp.companion.charmy.gift.love: %s! For me? You're the best, I love you!
nusmp.companion.charmy.gift.ok: Thanks! %s is not bad at all.
nusmp.companion.charmy.gift.hate: Ugh... %s? Even I won't eat that.
nusmp.companion.charmy.stance.passive: I'll stay out of it. Promise.
nusmp.companion.gs.story.none: Nothing yet. Talk, give gifts, walk together.
nusmp.companion.gs.put_hint: Click an item to hold it, then Put
nusmp.companion.gs.hint.bond: Drag an item onto her portrait to give it.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.portrait: She seems pleased that you looked at her.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.gift_slot: The gift slot: click to pick an item from your inventory.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.give: Give her the chosen item. Her answer shows what she thinks of it.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.meter: Rapport grows when you talk, give gifts she likes and walk together. The leaves light at 3, 10 and 25.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.meter.max: All three leaves are lit. She counts you a close friend.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.mood: How she feels right now. It follows what you say and give.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.follow.on: She walks with you. Click to ask her to wait here.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.follow.off: She is waiting here. Click to ask her to walk with you.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.ring.ready: She has something in the pouch to use when you are hurt (under two fifths of your health, at most every 30 seconds).
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.ring.empty: The switch is on, but the pouch holds nothing she would use. Put a healing potion or food in it.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.ring.off: The switch is off. She will leave the pouch alone.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.ring.locked: The pouch is not open to you now, so there is no switch.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.taste.loved: She loved this when you gave it.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.taste.liked: She liked this when you gave it.
nusmp.companion.gs.tip.taste.hated: She hated this when you gave it.
nusmp.companion.gs.ev.heal: She looked after you from the pouch
